title: Chapter 173
text:
After Han Xiao escaped from Mag's sight, he took a detour and returned to the route where the cameras were destroyed. He disguised himself, changed his face, and blended into the crowd, successfully getting rid of his pursuers.

After changing his appearance, Han Xiao rushed to the border without stopping. As expected, the sentry post was closed, and the special forces and soldiers searched everyone who passed by.

I'm so unlucky. I even got beaten up by a bunch of special agents when I was just shopping. Han Xiao cursed his bad luck in his mind. Antonio's words had come true, and he had really run into Ordina's intelligence agency. Based on his performance in battle, Ordina's intelligence agency would probably confirm that he was Black Phantom. There was no other way. In order to escape, he had to give it his all. Ordina's intelligence agency was still very useful.

Is it so hard to keep a low profile? Han Xiao felt helpless. Exposing his identity did not affect him much, as his whereabouts were unpredictable. However, he felt like he had tricked someone … Hmm, this is a small problem. Forget it.

At least this time, Han Xiaoxin got the Mini Bonfire Reactor. He was very satisfied.

Han Xiao remembered the location of the head of the snake. The sentry post did not affect his smuggling, and he could accept the reasonable increase in the smuggling fee.

…

It was already an hour later when he left the city from a secluded direction in Severus.

The rain had stopped, the clouds had dispersed, and the sun was shining brightly.

Han Xiao was on his way with his skateboard shoes when he suddenly received a call from Bennett.

"Why did Ordina's intelligence agency just contact the higher-ups of the organization to denounce us and ask for compensation? What did you do in the Western Continent?"

Bennett was very annoyed. He felt like trouble had fallen from the sky while he was sitting at home.

Ordina showed the evidence. Bennett recognized the voice of the person who made the transaction as Han Xiao. He was very annoyed.

Who would say that they sent their men over and did it themselves in the end? Even if you want to create confusion, don't make your battle mode so obvious!

It's very easy for people to misunderstand you, you old swindler!

"Well, it's just to keep my identity a secret, but it didn't seem to work … Oh, don't worry, it's not a big deal. I just had a fight with the people from Ordina, took out a few agents, and destroyed a few buildings. Everything else is fine, and Ordina is very hospitable … Speaking of which, the weather here is really bad. It's always raining, and it's gloomy and not bright at all. It's not as comfortable as the Southern Continent. I like the Southern Continent, where the weather is nice and the flowers bloom in spring."

Bennett was shocked. "How did you change the topic to the weather so naturally? Can you be any more rigid in changing the topic?"

Han Xiao laughed and said, "It was an accident. That's all. I still have something to do, so I'll hang up first."

"You f * cker …"

Before Bennett could finish his sentence, Han Xiao quickly hung up the phone and wiped the non-existent cold sweat off his forehead. He murmured, "What a mistake. I didn't expect Ordina to be so angry. Is there a need to …"

[Link] Complete.

You have gained 65000 EXP.

You have completed the hidden requirement: Stop Mag and help the mysterious merchant escape within three minutes.

Han Xiao raised an eyebrow. So that's the hidden requirement. Luckily, I didn't ask the seller to cover for me. At that time, he actually had two ideas. One was to protect himself. Since the target was not him, he could have let the seller attract the attention of the other party. However, Han Xiao chose the other option, which was to remind the seller to run first.

Seems like I made the right choice. Han Xiao smiled. The reward shouldn't be EXP. I have a player baby now, so I don't need EXP that much.

You have received a special reward — Character Summon Card — Dion.

Lv30 Special Dungeon Crystal — [Olena Infiltration Plan]

+ 30 Dion Favorability. Tradable.

"Dion?" Han Xiao frowned and thought for a while. Then, his eyes lit up. He remembered. This was a mysterious NPC on the Blue Star. He had a mysterious power hidden under the water. He was very low-key, and he bought and sold all kinds of rare materials. He was a hidden shop, and there were no fixed missions for the players to encounter him. They could only rely on the Goddess of Luck.

However, even if the players encountered a mission, they would miss the opportunity if they didn't complete the hidden requirement. For example, when the Goddess of Luck lifted her skirt, the players thought they could see the holy light, but she lifted her skirt and kicked the players to the ground.

He's the buyer this time … Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised.

His phone rang again. He looked at the number and saw that it was the seller.

"A hacker bugged my phone. I've already dealt with it. I won't leak any more secrets. I got you involved this time. I heard that Mag was sent to Ordina. If you didn't warn me, I might not have been able to escape. I owe you a favor."

"Since you called, it means that you want to return the favor." Han Xiao pretended to be mysterious, but he was laughing in his heart. After knowing the seller's background, he suddenly felt more confident.

"Dean, you can call me that," the seller said. "I don't do business with new customers, but you're an exception. I'll give you a 20% discount."

"Only 20%?" Han Xiao raised his voice. "Can you give me more?"

Dean was shocked by Han Xiao's shamelessness. He wondered why a legendary killer didn't have a mysterious style. After a moment of silence, he said, "20% … is quite a lot."

"Tsk."

Dean didn't continue the conversation. He felt that he would be led astray if he continued to talk about it.

Han Xiao soon received a message. It was a list of Dean's products. There were all kinds of rare things. He remembered that some of them were confidential research of the Six Nations.

There were also advanced machines. The bonfire was one of them. There were also a few nanomachines that Lei Zhen Yu had shown before. Lei Zhen Yu had also made a deal with Dean before.

Han Xiao was overjoyed. He could buy some new modules to assemble the mecha. The players in the two newbie villages in the Western Continent had given him a lot of money. He could spend it freely.

After quickly choosing a few machines, Han Xiao asked, "How do you want to trade?"

"It's still a meeting. This time, I'll give you a position in the wilderness three days later. I'll get someone to pass the items to you. My identity is more sensitive. For safety reasons, please understand that I don't want to do it personally. "

Han Xiaoxin was satisfied. His mecha was only one step away. As long as the new batch of materials arrived, he would be able to complete the assembly.

After hanging up, Han Xiao focused on the two special rewards. They were Dean's Character Summon Card and a level 30 rare Dungeon Crystal.

Character Summon Card: Dean

Ability: "You Can't See Me" (D) – Weakens the sense of presence. Causes perception deviation to any objects (including inanimate objects) that can see the user. Lasts 3 – 8 minutes. If the user attacks or is attacked, the status will be removed. Only those with INT or MYS higher than 180 will be immune.

Usage Count: 0/2

It's not a psychic Esper Ability or pure invisibility. It's an Esper Ability that changes with the environment. For example, if thermal imaging can see him, then his Esper Ability can hide his body heat. The other observation methods follow the same principle. What a rare Esper Ability.
